name: retail-pulse-major-project
description: Multi-Source E-Commerce Intelligence Suite (Retail Pulse, ShopPulse, TechMart & Connector)

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently --kill-others -n "connector,shoppulse,techmart,retailpulse" -c "magenta,blue,cyan,green" "npm --prefix retail-pulse-connector run dev" "npm --prefix Site1 run dev" "npm --prefix TechMart run dev" "npm --prefix RetailPulse run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix retail-pulse-connector run build && npm --prefix Site1 run build && npm --prefix TechMart run build && npm --prefix RetailPulse run build
